purpose: Optional targeted questions shown only after a participant first says an important Cognitive & Learning pattern is missing and then selects that pattern.
bias_control: Do not show the missing-pattern catalogue until the participant has first answered yes/no/unsure to whether an important part is missing.
Do not use follow-up responses to rewrite the original result during the same session.
Store follow-up responses as separate model-development observations.

questions.prompt: I often understand something before I can explain the steps by which I reached the understanding.
questions.reason: The current 26-item questionnaire does not directly measure the gap between insight formation and linear explanation.

questions.prompt: When work is inside an area that strongly matters to me, starting it is substantially easier than starting otherwise comparable work outside that area.
questions.reason: The current questionnaire measures overall Entry Threshold but not the within-person contrast between aligned and non-aligned domains.
